units.source_text: 那標籤已被指甲摳掉了一多半，但英文的一部分還留著，清楚寫著：DIAL。

en.t: Most of the label had been scratched off with fingernails, but part of the English remained, clearly spelling out: DIAL.

units.source_text: DIAL。那時我全靠燒酒助眠，沒服用過安眠藥。

en.t: DIAL. At that time I relied entirely on shochu to sleep and had never taken sleeping pills.

units.source_text: 但因為失眠是我的老毛病，所以對大部分安眠藥比較熟悉。

en.t: But because insomnia was an old chronic problem of mine, I was fairly familiar with most sleeping pills.

units.source_text: 一盒DIAL的量，足以致人於死地。

en.t: A single box of DIAL held enough to kill a person.

units.source_text: 盒子雖還沒拆開，但良子肯定動過輕生的念頭，

en.t: Although the box had not yet been opened, Yoshiko must certainly have thought of taking her own life,

units.source_text: 不然不會摳掉紙盒上標籤藏在糖罐裡吧。

en.t: otherwise she would not have scratched the label off the cardboard box and hidden it in the sugar jar.

units.source_text: 真的可憐，她因為看不懂標籤上的英文，才用指甲摳掉了一大半，

en.t: Poor thing, because she could not read the English on the label, she had scratched most of it off with her fingernails,

units.source_text: 以為這樣就不會有人發覺（她這樣也沒錯）。

en.t: thinking that no one would notice it that way, and in that she was not wrong.
